def bands_cells(inp):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in inp for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    def dom(s):
        c,_=Counter(s).most_common(1)[0]; return c
    hr=[i for i in range(H) if dom(inp[i])!=bg and sum(1 for x in inp[i] if x==dom(inp[i]))>=W*0.8]
    vc=[j for j in range(W) if dom([inp[i][j] for i in range(H)])!=bg and sum(1 for x in [inp[i][j] for i in range(H)] if x==dom([inp[i][k] for k in range(H)]))>=H*0.8]
    line=dom(inp[hr[0]])
    markers={c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,line)}
    R,C=len(hr)-1,len(vc)-1
    grid=[[bg]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            corners=[inp[hr[r+k]][vc[c+l]] for k in (0,1) for l in (0,1)]
            if len(set(corners))==1 and corners[0] in markers: grid[r][c]=corners[0]
    return grid
def f(inp):
    g=bands_cells(inp)
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(v!=g[0][0] and True for v in r)]
    # crop to bounding box of non-bg cells

    pos=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bgv]
    if not pos: return g
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pos); r1=max(p[0] for p in pos)
